name: MI683
tagline: Sleek inset fireplace with a bold glass frame trim
description: The MI683 is a modern cassette-style insert stove engineered to fit flush into wall recesses or fireplace openings. Encased in a durable outer chassis weighing 85kg, it features a highly insulated combustion chamber lined with heat-reflective vermiculite bricks for accelerated thermal delivery. The unit is framed by a minimalist, glossy black glass fascia and finished with a striking brushed steel vertical handle, offering an ultra-contemporary look for sophisticated spaces.
features: Flush-fitting insert design ideal for space-saving wall installations
Bold glossy black glass surrounding frame for a seamless minimalist aesthetic
Premium vermiculite internal lining for enhanced combustion temperatures
Sleek vertical brushed metal handle for smooth and secure door operation
Dedicated top flue outlet configuration optimized for standard chimney setups
